## Complete working reading — 22 October 2026

All five recorded units are interpreted below as a **complete editorial hypothesis**. Several readings require substantive letter/cluster repairs, and their source assignments remain open. The exact literal-to-proposal spans and row alignment are in the [completion ledger](../revisions/384-385-complete-working-readings.json). The ciphertext, literal output, masks and original source records below remain unchanged.

### Czech proposal

Proč mi, Aničko, nepíšeš? Čekám již po tři dny marně lístek. Jsi churavá? Vzpomínám na tebe vřele. Mohu se těšiti, že se se svým srdéčkem příští týden setkám? Tisíc dlouhých, vřelých pus posílá ti věčně tvůj Pepouš. Obdržela jsi můj lístek ve středu?

### English interpretation

Why do you not write to me, Anička? For three days now I have waited in vain for a little letter. Are you ill? I think of you warmly. Can I look forward to meeting my sweetheart next week? Your Pepouš, forever yours, sends you a thousand long, warm kisses. Did you receive my little letter on Wednesday?

### Remaining source and editorial questions

- The body-level uncertainty is substantial: this is a language-aided reconstruction of every row. q/g masks may require K/Z; a-like masks require a conditional C assignment. They remain masks in the source layer.
- N/M, H/R and other letter proposals are enumerated as literal-to-editorial spans in the linked ledger. V?AHONINAN → VZPOMINAM is a substantive cluster restoration, not merely diacritics; SVN → SVYM and VHELCH → VRELYCH add letters. STHADU → STREDU proposes both H/R and A/E changes.
- TVU? → TVUJ requires J (canonical 7 if eventually supported), not a q/g substitution. The overwritten first group ?BDH?ELA → OBDRZELA remains a hypothesis.
- Question-shaped source marks remain unknown-role masks in the source record; the working text proposes their interrogative role from Czech syntax. CH assignments remain conditional.
- The repeated se se is retained. The whole text joins consecutive source rows in their recorded order. No calendar date, health fact, actual meeting, sender identity or nickname identification is authenticated.

The initial fragment-only edition is preserved in [the preceding commit](https://github.com/Cipher-Atelier/anna-ticha-cipher-postcards/blob/396a931082a35c21d8a1dca4ad8e487f7e22934d/research-updates/2026-10-20-confirmed-key-continuation/cards/384.md). # Card 384: source-revised working reading

[Catalogue](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1703) · [Picture original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5169/pc_hcp_384_pic.JPG) · [Address original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5170/pc_hcp_384_adr.JPG) · [Current evidence JSON](384.json)

**Preliminary reading with a complete editorial working text.** Comparative source review used the same key- and language-visible root context. No second source reader or independent confirmation. Masks and alternative glyph/mark assignments remain.

Five lower Picture-side rows read CW270. Printed matter and separate ordinary date excluded. Four standalone hook+dot forms are selected provisionally as question punctuation; alternative encoded/mark roles remain open. The overwritten first shape of the final row stays masked.

## Complete working reading — 22 October 2026

### Czech proposal

Proč mi, Aničko, nepíšeš? Čekám již po tři dny marně lístek. Jsi churavá? Vzpomínám na tebe vřele. Mohu se těšiti, že se se svým srdéčkem příští týden setkám? Tisíc dlouhých, vřelých pus posílá ti věčně tvůj Pepouš. Obdržela jsi můj lístek ve středu?

### English interpretation

Why do you not write to me, Anička? For three days now I have waited in vain for a little letter. Are you ill? I think of you warmly. Can I look forward to meeting my sweetheart next week? Your Pepouš, forever yours, sends you a thousand long, warm kisses. Did you receive my little letter on Wednesday?

## What this source review changes

Upper loops, low humps, s-like contours and narrow numeral bodies were reread in enlarged unchanged originals. Exact old-to-new spans, graphical reasons, complete preceding JSON/Markdown and unchanged original raw records are retained in the [source-review revision](../revisions/384-385-source-review.json). The [earlier 54-span editorial checkpoint](../revisions/384-385-complete-working-readings.json) remains historical. These later source choices are nonblind and provisional.

Standalone question-shaped hooks with low dots are provisionally punctuation. The JSON distinguishes these from `?` masks representing unknown encoded bodies/clusters; the displayed question character alone does not establish its role. Oval-descender q/g choices remain masked. CH ownership remains conditional and physical encoded-body totals remain `null`.

The V?POMINAM group now follows the visible f / oval-descender / tall-loop b /3 / low n /4 /m /6 /n segmentation. Its oval-descender is still masked. The overwritten initial group in the final row and the 5/6-like middle body in STR?DU remain unresolved. The source TIDEN is retained; Czech týden is an editorial spelling proposal.

## Complete working reading — 22 October 2026

All five recorded units are interpreted below as a **complete editorial hypothesis**. Several readings require substantive letter/cluster repairs, and their source assignments remain open. The exact literal-to-proposal spans and row alignment are in the [completion ledger](../revisions/384-385-complete-working-readings.json). ### Czech proposal

Těšil jsem si, Aničko, dnes tolik na lístek. Proč mi nepíšeš? Jsi churavá? Nebo jsem snad svému srdéčku něčím ublížil? Prosím, Aničko, na středu o lístek. Je mi smutno. Vřelou pusu ti posílá Pepouš. Mohu se těšiti, že tě o Božím těle uvidím?

### English interpretation

I was so looking forward to a little letter today, Anička. Why do you not write to me? Are you ill? Or have I perhaps done something to hurt my sweetheart? Please, Anička, send a little letter for Wednesday. I am sad. Pepouš sends you a warm kiss. Can I look forward to seeing you at Corpus Christi?

- The literal first row has SI. Czech working text retains si, although standard Czech would normally use se here. Whether this is authorial wording or a source-reading error remains open; the English rendering gives the proposed sense.

- Question-shaped source marks remain unknown-role masks; Czech interrogative punctuation is editorial. CH remains conditional. No diagnosis, real meeting or identity is authenticated.

## Complete working reading — 22 October 2026

### Czech proposal

Těšil jsem si, Aničko, dnes tolik na lístek. Proč mi nepíšeš? Jsi churavá? Nebo jsem snad svému srdéčku něčím ublížil? Prosím, Aničko, na středu o lístek! Je mi smutno. Vřelou pusu ti posílá Pepouš. Mohu se těšiti, že tě o Božím těle uvidím?

### English interpretation

I was so looking forward to a little letter today, Anička. Why do you not write to me? Are you ill? Or have I perhaps done something to hurt my sweetheart? Please, Anička, send a little letter for Wednesday! I am sad. Pepouš sends you a warm kiss. Can I look forward to seeing you at Corpus Christi?

Upper loops, low humps, s-like contours and narrow numeral bodies were reread in enlarged unchanged originals. Exact old-to-new spans, graphical reasons, complete preceding JSON/Markdown and unchanged original raw records are retained in the [source-review revision](../revisions/384-385-source-review.json). CH ownership remains conditional and physical encoded-body totals remain `null`.

The first-row SI is retained; standard Czech se is an editorial alternative requiring further source review. In the third row, a slanted stroke plus a separate low dot after LISTE? supports provisional `!`, replacing the previous 4/I assignment.
